`markdown-it.cjs` is the unmodified standalone `dist/markdown-it.js` bundle from
markdown-it 14.1.1, renamed to `.cjs` for Node loading. Its MIT license is included.
Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-14.1.1.tgz
SHA-512 (base64): BuU2qnTti9YKgK5N+IeMubp14ZUKUUw7yeJbkjtosvHiP0AZ5c8IAgEMk79D0eC8F23r4Ac/q8cAIFdm2FtyoA==

The standalone bundle includes its parser dependencies, so the packaged extension
can render Markdown without npm dependencies or a network connection.
